title: Length, mass, capacity and time
goal: I can use the units mm, cm, m, km, g, kg, ml, l and change between them, and work with hours and minutes.
teach: We measure length in mm, cm, m and km, mass in g and kg, and capacity in ml and l. Remember: 1 m = 100 cm, 1 km = 1 000 m, 1 kg = 1 000 g, 1 l = 1 000 ml. To change to a smaller unit, multiply (there will be more of them). To change to a bigger unit, divide.
watch: Write the unit with every answer. 3 m and 3 cm are very different lengths.

qs.text: How many millilitres are in 2 l?

qs.hint: To change to a bigger unit, divide by 100.
qs.steps:
1. Rule: 1 m = 100 cm, 1 cm = 10 mm, 1 km = 1 000 m. To change to a smaller unit, multiply; to change to a bigger unit, divide.
2. cm → m is a bigger unit, so divide by 100.
3. 500 ÷ 100 = 5 m

qs.text: How many minutes are in 2 hours?
qs.steps:
1. Rule: 1 hour = 60 minutes, 1 minute = 60 seconds, 1 day = 24 hours, 1 week = 7 days.
2. 2 hours = 2 × 60 minutes
3. = 120 minutes
